label: The most-real-to-actual step needs EXISTENCE_8; a Kantian identification model
paraphrase: Checked facts, analyst formulation. (a) For every ontic model, reality profile and world: if existence at that world is a real predicate (EXISTENCE_8), every most-real candidate exists there. (b) Some model, profile and world satisfy Kant's thesis that existence is not a real predicate, the reported identification premise 'every necessary being is most real' and the strong uniqueness of most-real candidates, and have a most-real candidate, while no most-real candidate exists there and no necessary being exists. So the step from the concept of the most real to existence needs the real-predicate sense, and the identification and uniqueness premises do not supply an existing witness.
